source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names (surname and other names) as in the Returning Officer's notice of result, which lists the members ward by ward (North, South, Waterside) in alphabetical order; ward assignment follows that order and the Journal's ward nomination reports; party by ward as the Journal's reports state (official Unionist Party in the North and Waterside wards, Nationalists in the South Ward)

note: Triennial election of Londonderry Corporation (all twenty members: five aldermen and fifteen councillors), due Wednesday 20 May 1964: no poll. Two Independents nominated for the North Ward, Raymond Wolseley and Mrs Winifred Haslett, withdrew their nominations, leaving the official Unionist and Nationalist nominees unopposed (Derry Journal, 8 May 1964, p. 15). The Returning Officer's notice of result lists the five aldermen and fifteen councillors as duly elected with no votes recorded (Derry Journal, 26 May 1964, p. 7). A Unionist nominee was switched from the North Ward to the Waterside on nomination day (Derry Journal, 8 May 1964, p. 15). Returned unopposed.
